strict.criterion: AI achieves general human-level intellectual competence under an explicitly demanding broad-capability reading.
strict.rationale: The 2029 target is pending. Strong language and benchmark performance provides major partial progress; a short imitation game does not establish the complete general-intelligence claim.

evidence.title: Large Language Models Pass the Turing Test — Jones and Bergen
evidence.note: Five-minute experimental protocol. GPT-4.5 with a humanlike persona was judged human in 73% of the reported comparisons. Not the two-hour Long Bets protocol.

broader.criterion: AI achieves broadly human-level intellectual performance across language, reasoning, and knowledge tasks by 2029.
broader.rationale: The 2029 deadline has not arrived. Frontier LLMs pass short five-minute conversational imitation tests (Jones & Bergen 2025) and match or exceed humans on many benchmarks, representing major partial progress—but declaring general human-level intelligence fulfilled in 2026 from a five-minute chat study is premature.
changedConditions: Treats short conversational imitation tests as strong partial progress without prematurely marking a 2029 AGI claim On time
